title: Simply Shaded
description: The only shaderpack designed for Maximum FPS.
body:
# Simply Shaded

A minimal Iris shaderpack built for one goal: **maximum FPS**. No shadows, no post-processing, no bloat — just the lightest possible shader pipeline with a touch of visual polish where it doesn't cost anything.

From my testing, my FPS went from 134 without shaders to 121 with. This is barely any drop compared to most other packs.

## Why it's fast

- **No shadow pass.** Shadow maps are usually the single most expensive part of a shaderpack. Simply Shaded skips them entirely.
- **No composite/deferred passes.** There's no extra full-screen post-processing running every frame.
- **Minimal gbuffer shaders.** Every shader does the bare minimum: sample the texture, multiply by vertex color, multiply by the lightmap. That's it.

## Features

- Near-vanilla performance with Iris enabled
-  Correct mob hit-flash / glow effects preserved

## Requirements
Iris 

OR

Optifine

## Installation

1. Download the file below
2. Drop it into your `.minecraft/shaderpacks` folder
3. In-game: Video Settings → Shader Packs → select **Simply Shaded**

## Who is this for?

Anyone who wants Iris's compatibility benefits without the FPS hit of a full shaderpack — low-end PCs, competitive/PvP players who want max framerate, or anyone who just doesn't want shadows tanking their FPS.
